ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle AOB$ is an isosceles right triangle. If $A(-4, 1)$, what are the coordinates of point $B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, draw AE$\perp$x-axis at E through point A, and draw BF$\perp$x-axis at F through point B,\\
$\therefore \angle$AEO=$\angle$OFB=$90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle$AOE+$\angle$OAE=$90^\circ$,\\
Also, $\because \angle$AOB=$90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle$AOE+$\angle$BOF=$90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle$OAE=$\angle$BOF,\\
$\because$AO=OB,\\
$\therefore \triangle$OAE$\cong \triangle$BOF (AAS),\\
$\therefore$OF=AE, BF=OE,\\
$\because$the coordinates of point A are (-4, 1),\\
$\therefore$OF=AE=1, BF=OE=4,\\
$\therefore$the coordinates of point B are $\boxed{(1,4)}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The intersection point of the coordinate axes in the figure is labeled O, and can be regarded as the coordinate origin; point A is located to the upper left of O, and point B is located to the upper right of O. There is a right-angle mark at O in the figure, indicating that OA and OB are perpendicular; the problem states that triangle AOB is an isosceles right triangle, so OA and OB are two equal right-angle sides. Reasoning: Given A=(-4,1), therefore vector OA=(-4,1). Because OB is perpendicular to OA and has the same length, OB can be obtained by rotating OA 90° around O. In the figure, OB is located in the first quadrant, so OA should be rotated 90° clockwise: (-4,1) -> (1,4). Therefore the coordinates of point B are (1,4).

method.method_draft: Use slope and distance equations. From the image, first note that O is the origin, the right-angle marker is at O, and B is on the first-quadrant ray from O. From the text, A=(-4,1), so slope of OA is 1/(-4)=-1/4 and length OA is sqrt((-4)^2+1^2)=sqrt(17). Since OB is perpendicular to OA, its slope must be 4, so B=(x,4x). Since the triangle is isosceles with right angle at O, OB=OA, so x^2+(4x)^2=17. Hence 17x^2=17, and because B is in the first quadrant, x=1, y=4. Therefore B=(1,4).
